topQueries.query: SELECT p0.id, p0.name, p0.description, p0.price, p0.image_path, p0.category_id, c.name, p0.created_at FROM ( SELECT p.id, p.category_id, p.created_at, p.description, p.image_path, p.name, p.price FROM products.products AS p WHERE p.category_id = $1 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3 ) AS p0 INNER JOIN products.categories AS c ON p0.category_id = c.id ORDER BY p0.created_at DESC, p0.id
SELECT count(*)::int FROM orders.orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id = $1
SELECT count(*)::int FROM products.products AS p
SELECT count(*)::int FROM products.products AS p WHERE p.category_id = $1
INSERT INTO orders.order_lines (id, line_total, order_id, product_id, product_name, quantity, unit_price) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)

SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.status, o.total, ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(o0.quantity), $4)::int FROM orders.order_lines AS o0 WHERE o.id = o0.order_id), o.created_at, o.updated_at FROM orders.orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id = $1 ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.description, p.price, p.image_path, p.category_id, c.name, p.created_at FROM products.products AS p INNER JOIN products.categories AS c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.id = $1 LIMIT $2
